respuesta.razonamiento: All visual boxes match the spoken services directly: TVs (UserConsumerTV), Kinesis Data Streams (KinesisDataStream), Kinesis Data Firehose (Firehose), Redshift (RedShift), S3 (S3), and QuickSight (QuickSight). SPICE was mentioned as an internal in-memory database feature of QuickSight rather than an independent service, so it is recorded in QuickSight's notes. The visual diagram has bidirectional connections between multiple services, which correspond to data loading, staging, and querying flows.
